# Yahoo Sports

> > Yahoo Sports is a comprehensive sports news and fantasy gaming platform offering live scores, standings, video coverage, and interactive fantasy leagues across major U.S. and international sports.

Yahoo Sports provides real-time coverage of professional and college sports including NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and college football/basketball, alongside fantasy sports games, sports betting odds, and 24/7 streaming content. The platform aggregates news, schedules, live updates, and highlights from major sporting events including March Madness and the Olympics.

## Key Topics

- March Madness
- Fantasy Sports
- Live Scores & Standings
- NCAA Tournament
- Sports News
- College Basketball
- Fantasy Baseball
- Fantasy Football
- Live Games
- Sports Betting Odds
- Team Coverage
- Highlights & Video
- Schedules
- Yahoo Sports TV
- Daily Draw

## Major Professional Sports

- [NFL News, Scores, Standings, Schedules, Videos and more](https://sports.yahoo.com/nfl): NFL news, scores, standings, schedules and video highlights hub
- [NBA News, Scores, Standings, Schedules, Videos and more](https://sports.yahoo.com/nba): NBA news, scores, standings, schedules and live video coverage
- [MLB News, Scores, Standings, Schedules, Videos and more](https://sports.yahoo.com/mlb): MLB news, scores, standings, fantasy baseball and live game coverage
- [NHL News, Scores, Standings, Schedules, Videos and more](https://sports.yahoo.com/nhl): NHL news, scores, standings, schedules and playoff updates
- [WNBA News, Scores, Standings, Schedules, Videos and more](https://sports.yahoo.com/wnba): WNBA news, scores, standings and women's professional basketball coverage
